description: This file defines the SaveLocationController class, which manages the rendering and permission setup for location-related views in the OrangeHRM admin interface. It handles pre-render logic, including component instantiation and setting permissions, and interacts with the CountryService to populate location data.

classes.name: SaveLocationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling save location operations, including setting up components and permissions based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares components and permissions before rendering, based on request attributes.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for capability permission checks.
